cli.--generate: actually generate answers and score the checklist (~10s per turn)
cli.--sample N: stratified sample of N scenarios; 25+ needed to cover all 21 kinds
cli.--repeat K: repeat K times to produce pass^K
cli.--verbose: print every failure instead of the first 15
cli.--latency: print generation time. Upstream explicitly warns this is desktop LLM-server timing, NOT device latency, and must not be cited as a performance figure

default_mode: dry_run = not args.generate  -> dry-run is the default
warmup: ask('워밍업', [], None, [], None, True) before any scenario; on failure prints a hint and returns 1
output: stdout only - json.dump / open(...,'w') / write_text appear 0 times

exit_code_contract.0: returned whenever the run completes, REGARDLESS of how many scenarios failed
exit_code_contract.1: returned only when the warmup connection fails
exit_code_contract.warning: exit code 0 does NOT mean pass; a wrapper must parse the failure count and denominators independently

official_gate: NONE - no threshold comparison exists anywhere in the file
gate_can_change_after_seeing_results: not applicable in code, but this is exactly why the gate must be pre-registered externally

known_gap.handling: accumulated into a separate stats['gap'] object, excluded from headline numbers
